card.name: Words before a range or baseline
card.fires_on: Small linking words or gaps right before a target value, such as 'to' after 'return', 'from' after 'excursions permitted', or the space before a range like 15° to 30°C.

modes.label: Return to baseline
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'return' in instructions to withhold a drug until a lab value or grade recovers.
modes.example: Withhold KRAZATI until recovery to ≤ Grade 1 or return<< to>> baseline.

modes.label: Storage excursion ranges
modes.description: 'from' or a space just before the temperature range allowed for excursions.
modes.example: Store the ELUCIREM IBP at 25° C (77° F); excursions permitted<< from>> 15°C to 30

modes.label: Dose range gaps
modes.description: A space after a dash inside a dose range in a table.

card.plain: It fires on the small word or gap just before a baseline or a range of values, as in 'return to baseline' or 'excursions permitted from 15°C to 30°C'.
